prompt: Why is the cloth clip a better place to put the woman’s name than the paper itself?
promptZh: 為什麼夾布的夾子比紙本身更適合標註女子的姓名？

options.text: The sheet is already dry and the clip tells her which tray to use.
options.zh: 紙已乾，夾子會指示她用哪個托盤。
options.whyZh: 紙底仍黏住，標名也不是為了分配托盤。

options.text: The paper will be taken home now and the name is only for the other tray.
options.zh: 紙現在要帶回去，姓名只是給另一個托盤用。
options.whyZh: 她將紙留到隔天，也不使用當日取件托盤。

options.text: The name tells staff to move the sheet without its cloth.
options.zh: 姓名是通知工作人員搬紙時不要連布一起。
options.whyZh: 紙目前應平放在布上，不應單獨從布上拿起。

options.text: It identifies the sheet left overnight without marking the sheet itself.
options.zh: 可辨認留到明天的作品，又不把名字寫在作品上。
options.whyZh: 女子須提早離開且想隔天再取；指定在夾布的夾子上標名，使紙本身不必被寫上名字。

explanationZh: 女子須提早離開且想隔天再取；指定在夾布的夾子上標名，使紙本身不必被寫上名字。
evidence: Can I leave it here until tomorrow? / Write your name on the little holder that grips the cloth. Do not write on the paper.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Can I leave it here until tomorrow?

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Write your name on the little holder that grips the cloth. Do not write on the paper.

vocabulary.note: grip 指夾牢；把姓名寫在夾具上可避免直接在紙上留下字跡。
